北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感-10℃，记得多穿衣物，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is gloomy and feels like -10℃. Remember to dress warmly to stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，出行请注意交通安全，湿度大，感觉会有点湿冷。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, please drive safely. High humidity makes it feel a bit damp and cool.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 9℃ 略有凉意，别忘了添件外套。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 9℃. A bit chilly, don't forget your jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 25℃ 舒适宜人，享受这美好天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is partly cloudy, 25℃ is delightful. Enjoy the lovely weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，气温 26℃ 暖洋洋的，出门感受阳光吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm at 26℃. Go out and enjoy the sunshine!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，气温 11℃ 略凉，出行注意防护，保暖哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has haze and it's 11℃. Protect yourself outdoors and stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京霾且有风，体感 6℃，出行注意防护，并多加衣物。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is hazy and windy, feels like 6℃. Take precautions and dress warmly.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，气温 17℃，体感舒适，是出门的好天气。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and 17℃, feeling pleasant. A great day to be out!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 7℃ 较冷，注意防护，记得多穿点。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels like 7℃. It's quite cold, so protect yourself and dress warmly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗但体感 5℃，空气干燥，记得保暖并补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels like 5℃. The air is dry, stay warm and hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，气温 16℃ 适中，但记得出门做好防护。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, 16℃ is moderate. Remember to protect yourself when going out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗但极寒，体感-25℃，请务必全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold, feels like -25℃. Dress in full layers to fight the cold!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感-19℃，出门多穿几层，注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels like -19℃. Wear extra layers when going out and stay warm.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，气温 16℃，体感 11℃，早晚注意添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and 16℃, feels like 11℃. Add layers in the morning and evening.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温 23℃ 舒适宜人，很适合户外活动。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, 23℃ feels comfortable. Perfect for outdoor activities.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感-3℃，海边风大，注意防寒保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like -3℃. The seaside is windy, so bundle up!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感-13℃，风力 3级，务必做好防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -13℃ with a level 3 wind. Be sure to stay warm and protected from the wind.
